# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Exact Semantic Change Report r0.8

Comparison base: Git commit
`be5c12ea6aba11635fb4da4e869403066c53912f` (`v0.1-stage-a-r0.7`)

Target: `v0.1-stage-a-r0.8` focused ODQ-001F owner-review repair

Status: **Stage A documentation-only change report**

## Changed Semantics

1. The deliverable is explicitly an ODQ-001F focused owner-review subset, not
   the complete Stage A packet. Exact contents and omissions are manifest-bound.
2. The exact final candidate decision binds the complete architecture and its
   mandatory safeguards; approval of a short sentence is no longer sufficient.
3. The overloaded qualification tuple is retired in favor of separate
   `METHOD_ID`, `CLAIM_ID`, `EVIDENCE_ID`, and `QUALIFICATION_DECISION`.
   Parent route is part of the method; evidence generation is not.
4. The claim-layer sequence now separates qualification, qualified-method
   record, sealed author packet, Stage B authorship, owner freeze, conformity,
   validation/achieved performance, readiness, and production authorization.
5. Qualification access now freezes candidate-family size, submissions,
   blinding/unblinding, historical-control outcome access, sequential/reuse,
   multiplicity, gatekeeping, effect credibility, and replacement populations.
6. Replication now requires an explicit inference target, independent unit,
   clustering, pairing, cluster-aware inference, effective sample size,
   missingness, and supported claim domain. The conservative default is the
   exact finite held-out population.
7. Paired reporting now retains rescue, regression, joint failure, scientific
   unavailability, known inapplicability, common support, support gain/loss,
   and exact denominators rather than post-hoc complete pairs.
8. Operational stopping is restricted to causal ordinary diagnostics; oracle
   evaluation, time-to-quality censoring, caps, oscillation, and drift remain
   separate. Output-changing caps belong to `METHOD_ID`.
9. Ratio metrics now have a minimum truth domain or near-zero alternate;
   weights have prospective positivity/commonness rules; `D_j^2` is labeled
   population dispersion; nuisance tests require signed/multi-amplitude and
   fixed/full-procedure distinctions; time-to-quality retains censored/failure
   outcomes.
10. Historical scientific control, historical compatibility candidate, and
    authorized operational fallback are separate. No operational fallback is
    authorized, and historical Citlali is not called the v0.1 production method.
11. Motivating profile names are generic recovery regimes. OOF and SZE remain
    downstream motivating populations unless separately placed in a domain.

## Preserved Semantics

The repair preserves exact historical Citlali as paired control rather than
truth; baseline-relative qualification; protected noninferiority plus material
prioritized improvement; absolute truth/null evidence; Pareto comparison with
no scalar default; development/qualification/challenge separation;
prospective freeze; tail/stratum/failure/catastrophic safeguards;
fixed/bounded-adaptive/override distinctions; replay/restart; fixed-state and
complete-procedure response/uncertainty; the Stage A/Stage B firewall;
downstream OOF/SZE ownership; and no-replacement as a valid result.

## Exact Non-Effects

No implementation or implementation-derived data were inspected or modified
for this repair. No empirical lane, prototype, benchmark, qualification access,
Stage B packet, recurrence, parent route, profile, population, metric,
threshold, parameter/adaptation policy, stopping rule, method, validation,
readiness, production change, operational fallback, or Unity work is selected
or authorized. ODQ-001F remains open pending explicit acceptance of the exact
content-bound final candidate.
